+import treq
+from twisted.internet import reactor, threads

@@ -16,6 +18,52 @@
 tokens = Blueprint('tokens', __name__)
 token_schema = TokenSchema()
 oauth2_schema = OAuth2Schema()
+_reactor_ready = Event()
+_reactor_started = False
+
+
+def _run_reactor():
+    reactor.callWhenRunning(_reactor_ready.set)
+    reactor.run(installSignalHandlers=False)
+
+
+def _ensure_reactor_running():
+    global _reactor_started
+    if reactor.running:
+        return
+    if not _reactor_started:
+        _reactor_started = True
+        Thread(target=_run_reactor, daemon=True).start()
+        _reactor_ready.wait()
+
+
+def _treq_call(func, *args, **kwargs):
+    _ensure_reactor_running()
+    return threads.blockingCallFromThread(reactor, func, *args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class _TreqResponse:
+
+    def __init__(self, response):
+        self._response = response
+        self.status_code = response.code
+        self.code = self.status_code
+
+    def json(self):
+        return _treq_call(treq.json_content, self._response)
+
+
+class _TreqRequests:
+
+    def post(self, url, data=None, headers=None):
+        return _TreqResponse(_treq_call(
+            treq.post, url, data=data, headers=headers))
+
+    def get(self, url, headers=None):
+        return _TreqResponse(_treq_call(treq.get, url, headers=headers))
+
+
+requests = _TreqRequests()
